before: The summary was shown: every Tuesday 9:00 am, 2 drafts for Instagram and LinkedIn about new menu items, each with an image made from the post and the brand's look; they wait for your yes; images use extra credits and step down to text if credits run short.

arguments.name: Tuesday menu posts with images
arguments.goal: 2 posts about new menu items every Tuesday, each with an image
arguments.instructions: Posts about new menu items. Never invent facts, numbers, prices or dates.

steps.why: weekly_social_posts takes media; many other kinds refuse it. No media_prompt: each image is drawn from its post. No image_model: automatic. No reference_media_id: there was no id to use.
Switching on is not running. Nothing is drawn or charged until the first run.
Read next_run_at (UTC) and say it in the brand's clock; check output_config kept media_mode image.

say: Bolta routine on. First drafts with images Tue Nov 17, 9:00 am (Chicago). If credits run short, that week's drafts come without images, and an Instagram draft needs an image added before it can post. On Tuesday, say 'what's waiting'.
never: run-routine-now in the same breath: it draws images and spends credits, so it needs its own yes.
Promising images on a kind of routine that refuses media.
Inventing a reference_media_id: only one the user gives or get-routine shows.
Sending a carousel_config with media_mode image.
